summary: Summer road trip coming up? Don't trust worn tires on the highway. Before the long drives start, swing by Prince Tires for a quick tread and pressure check. We'll tell you straight whether your tires are road-trip ready, no upsell. Most stocked sizes installed in about 45 minutes if you do need a fresh set. Family-owned, 4.9 stars from 562+ Calgary drivers.

Camping season means trailer tire season. Are yours rated for the load? Trailer and RV tires age out by date, not just tread, and the wrong load range is a blowout waiting to happen. We stock trailer tires and can check your load range before you tow. Call us at (403) 452-4283.

Found a lower price in Calgary? We'll match it. Bring us a local competitor's quote on the same tire and we'll match it, then back it with free re-torque after install. Best price and honest service. 26 brands in stock, from Michelin to budget-friendly picks.

All-season vs all-weather, which one actually suits Calgary? They sound the same; they're not. All-weather tires carry the 3PMSF snowflake and are legal for Alberta winters; all-season tires aren't. If you'd rather not swap twice a year, ask us which all-weather set fits your vehicle and budget.

Canada Day long weekend, drive safe Calgary. We're open our usual hours heading into the long weekend (Mon to Sat 9:30 to 5:30). Walk-ins welcome if you spot a slow leak or want a pre-trip check before you hit the highway. Call ahead and we'll get you in.

New season, new look, wheels and rims in stock. Summer's the time to upgrade the stance. We carry wheels and rims from 26 brands including XF Off-Road, RTX, and ENVY, mounted and balanced in-house. Tell us your vehicle and we'll find a fit.

When did you last rotate your tires? Rotating your tires keeps the tread wearing evenly so your set lasts longer, cheap insurance against buying tires early. Quick to do while you wait. Book a rotation online in under a minute.

Why Calgary drivers keep coming back to a family shop. No call-centre, no runaround, just honest advice and fair pricing from a family-owned shop that's earned 4.9 stars from 562+ reviews. Most tire jobs done same-day. Come see the difference. 111 42 Ave SW.
